# Overleaf LaTeX Project

**Paper:** SSL Pretraining with SGD Creates Geometrically Stable Spurious Shortcut Encodings: Measurement and a SAM-Based Intervention Protocol

**Generated by:** Phase 6.5.1 pipeline

## Structure

```
overleaf/
├── main.tex              # Main document
├── references.bib        # BibTeX references
├── icml2025.sty          # ICML 2025 style file
├── icml2025.bst          # BibTeX style
├── algorithm.sty         # Algorithm package
├── algorithmic.sty       # Algorithmic package
├── figures/
│   ├── fig_wga_comparison.png
│   ├── fig_training_dynamics.png
│   └── fig_group_accuracy.png
└── sections/
    ├── abstract.tex
    ├── introduction.tex
    ├── related_work.tex
    ├── methodology.tex
    ├── experiments.tex
    ├── results.tex
    ├── discussion.tex
    ├── conclusion.tex
    └── appendix.tex
```

## Compilation

```bash
pdflatex main.tex
bibtex main
pdflatex main.tex
pdflatex main.tex
```

Or upload to Overleaf — set compiler to pdfLaTeX.
